notes: Read all five units, full right-of-return and self-determination context, all fourteen candidates and the review. Identified return as Palestinians' return to their homeland, retained Palestinians as the safety-and-dignity beneficiaries, replaced the boot metaphor with its Israeli-oppression referent, and restored Palestinian agency and freedom to build their own society. Also restored the explicit rejection of handouts.

claims.claim_text: Palestinians' return to their homeland is characterized as the first step toward historic justice and decolonizing Palestinian lands.
Demand that all Palestinians have freedom to thrive and live safely and with dignity.
Israeli structural violence and systematic destruction of Palestinian lives and livelihoods prevent Palestinians from thriving.
Demand that Palestinians have the freedom to build their own just and liberated society free of classism, patriarchy, homophobia, racism and all forms of bigotry.
